courseTitle: Ionic - Build iOS, Android & Web Apps with Ionic & Angular

cues.en: As always, you find more in the official docs here in the guide section under theming.
There, you can learn how theming generally works,
you can learn more about CSS variables and so on but I will walk you through the important concepts
but one thing I want to bring to your attention right now already is this CSS utilities thing here.
Now we had a look at this a couple of times already throughout this course, I'm talking about these utilities
CSS attributes you can add to any element to for example align your text or to align your items
in an Ionic grid and so on.
Now this is of course also related to styling,
these are just some default styles which you can by the way also adjust through CSS variables but
more on that later, that you can drop on any element in your application.
So definitely be aware of this page and feel free to dive into it if you need some general styling like
I want to add a margin,
well then you can just drop the margin attribute on the item instead of writing your own CSS rule.
But with that, let's dive into our actual code now and play around with the theme and so on.
